panels.title: Live edge by MLB game (size- & volume-vetted)

options.content:
**Edge = best cross-venue `bid − ask` (¢).** A row is a *real* opportunity only when **Edge > 3.25¢ (fee wall) AND Size ≥ 10 contracts AND the market has actually traded in the last 5 min** — a wide edge on a thin or untraded book (a lone maker repricing an illiquid quote) is a phantom, not an arb.

The universe is now **MLB daily games only** (narrowed 2026-08-28): the static cross-category markets were thin and repriced on zero volume, so their edges were phantom. The **Size ≥ 10** gate is the same liquidity floor the recorder now enforces on its paper trades (`min_depth`). This surface is a **monitor**; predbot paper-trades these in the background to measure whether an MLB edge survives — live execution stays parked until it does.
**Contracts is signed** — positive = long YES, **negative = a short / naked leg** (read straight from each venue's account every 15s). Empty when flat.

panels.title: Unhedged contracts by market (nonzero = a leg without its hedge)

options.content: `predbot_unhedged_contracts` is nonzero whenever a leg filled without its hedge. Cross-reference the `predbot-live` journal: **`PAIR OUTCOME`** lines classify every placement (HEDGED / HEDGED_PARTIAL / LEGGED / BOTH_ZERO), and **`position reconciliation`** lines log venue-vs-belief every 30s.

title: predbot
description: MLB-only cross-venue arb monitor (Kalshi <-> Polymarket US). Narrowed 2026-08-28 to MLB daily games + a 10-contract liquidity floor, after the recorded data showed the fast, real edges are on MLB games and the thin static markets were phantom. Paper mode, no real money — gathering data on whether an MLB edge actually survives; live execution parked (reversible).
